title: Birch ply wardrobe, desk and cupboards
summary: A small room fitted out in birch ply: tall wardrobe, cupboards overhead and a wall-hung desk.
intro: A small room in Chiswick, fitted out wall to wall in birch ply. A tall wardrobe on one side, cupboards running overhead, and a wall-hung desk with a drawer under the window, lit by a wall lamp. The outside wall was insulated and lined first, so everything fixes to something solid.
